notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes: [p]📢 Today’s Update is Live![/p][p]Hey heroes, here’s what we’ve rolled out in today’s patch:[/p][p]- Losing game data on crash issue fixed[/p][p]- Laser skill mechanic in combat improved[/p][p]- Phone screen hover stick issue fixed[/p][p]- Added remaining time to reach the tasks[/p][p]- Market job payment adjustment[/p][p]- More encouraging comments from notifications added[/p][p]- Task spawn frequency adjustment done, more option and freedom on that will come in next update[/p][p]- Mental and health increase in home adjustment[/p][p]- Opening tab while the fridge is open locking the game bug fixed[/p][p]- Level 20 boss missile speed fix[/p][p]- Police officer sounds fix[/p][p]Thanks for playing and supporting us! Every update is shaped by your feedback keep it coming! 💙[/p]

notes.title: Release Date Update!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone! We’ve decided to push the release of our game to September 18. We’re adding more features, more content, and more fun, all to make sure you get the best possible experience on day one.[/p][p]We’re incredibly excited about what’s coming and we promise it’ll be worth the wait. Thanks for your patience and support! We can’t wait to show you what we’ve been working on! [/p]
